source_scope: Generic five-stage benchmark topology; intake supplies only the Kaggle homepage, no historical solution or source implementation.
implementation_choices: Possessions estimated from field-goal attempts plus caller coefficient times free-throw attempts minus offensive rebounds plus turnovers. Ratios aggregate totals rather than averaging per-game ratios.
Directed PageRank edges transfer one unit per loss to the winner, retaining repeated games. Rank is a declared graph feature, not a certified true strength-of-schedule estimate.
Each season resets Elo with explicit initial value, K and scale; neutral matchup update without margin or home advantage. Game ordering must be explicit and unique.
Feature vectors concatenate both teams and their differences. Standardization fits only training seasons. Mirrored matchups augment training and calibration.
Disjoint ordered seasons for training, calibration and prediction; regular games must end before each corresponding target matchup.

Frozen base classifier with sigmoid calibration on one explicit held-out population; no base refit. Final orientation-symmetric probability projection is explicit and not an empirical calibration guarantee.
